description: List the agent's UI skills - the rich WhatsApp components (carousels, CTA URLs, flows, images, interactive lists and buttons, location) the agent may send, each with the instruction that says when to send it. A UI skill is NOT an agent skill (mba_list_agent_skills): an agent skill is instruction text that shapes what the agent says, a UI skill lets the agent send one kind of rich WhatsApp component and tells it when to send that component. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

name: mba_list_ui_skills

outputSchema.description: A paginated list of UI skills

component_type.description: The type of rich message this UI skill sends. Known values: carousel_quick_reply, carousel_url, cta_url, flow, image, interactive_list, interactive_reply_buttons, location, location_request.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the UI skill was created

flow_id.description: The identifier of the associated flow. Only present for flow skills

id.description: A unique identifier for the UI skill

instruction.description: A description telling the AI agent when to send this UI skill

status.description: Whether this UI skill is enabled and available to the AI agent. Known values: disabled, enabled.

title.description: A human-readable name for the UI skill

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the UI skill was last updated

cursors.description: Cursors to the next and previous pages

after.description: The cursor that points to the end of the page of data that has been returned

before.description: The cursor that points to the start of the page of data that has been returned

next.description: The API that will return the next page of data. If not included, this is the last page of data. Due to how pagination works with visibility and privacy, a page may be empty but still carry a next link, so stop paging when the next link no longer appears

previous.description: The API that will return the previous page of data. If not included, this is the first page of data

title: List UI skills
